title: Mietemasu yo! Aizawa-san
titleNative: 見えてますよ! 愛沢さん
synopsis: Michi has always been troubled by the fact that she can see ghosts. She pretends not to see, trying not to get involved. However, a ghost has appeared that even she cannot ignore. It is Honami Aizawa, a former member of the popular idol group De:LPhinus. She was also a classmate of Michi, and she haunts the classroom out of unfulfilled longing. Michi is determined not to get involved with ghosts, but she finds herself following Honami's childish and outlandish behavior, unable to look away from her ardent fan-service(?)....... (Source: Comic Valkyrie, translated)

title: Mogura no Uta
titleNative: 土竜の唄
synopsis: Tanibukuro city's Officer Kikukawa Reiji is the problem child of the police force. He doesn't always follow protocol and he enforces justice through his own personal morals. But it was that exact unwavering sense of righteousness that convinced the chief of police that Reiji was a perfect fit for a top secret undercover mission. He is given the task of infiltrating the Sukiya organization, the biggest and most dangerous mafia group of the Kanto region, and find solid evidence to arrest its leader Todoroki Shuho. But being accepted and trusted in the mafia means Reiji has to do unthinkable things and put himself in dangerous situations where one little slip and his life would be over. (Source: MangaHelpers)

synopsis: A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!? When the poor university student Sanosuke Saraki started at a new part-time job at his old high school, he unexpectedly reunites with Koharu Kobachi, a classmate that he admired as a brilliant genius.
